870bc5f530a680261302f823b5c4f599.overview: Aging sidekick Lefty Brown has ridden with Eddie Johnson his entire life. But when a rustler kills Eddie, Lefty is forced from his partner’s shadow and must confront the ugly realities of frontier justice.
870bc5f530a680261302f823b5c4f599.tagline: He never wanted to be the hero

870ca22de29db82256046d80fc47b2f4.overview: Seriously ill, concert pianist Karen Duncan is admitted to a Swiss sanitorium. Despite being attracted to Dr Tony Stanton she ignores his warnings of possibly fatal consequences unless she rests completely. Rather, she opts for a livelier time in Monte Carlo with dashing Paul Clermont.
870ca22de29db82256046d80fc47b2f4.tagline: Few Women Dare Live It... Few Men Dare Give It...

872b1848a7761f07dce2d72586a97dbf.overview: Nineteen-year-old Danny Flynn is imprisoned for his involvement with the I.R.A. in Belfast. He leaves behind his family and his sixteen-year-old girlfriend, Maggie Hamill. Fourteen years later, Danny is released from prison and returns to his old working class neighborhood to resume his life as a boxer.
872b1848a7761f07dce2d72586a97dbf.tagline: Love is always worth fighting for.

8756761e0e6b425a9ba9e50400f93e49.overview: During the 1980s, uptight Ted Boynton is a salesman working in the Barcelona office of a Chicago-based company. He receives an unexpected visit from his cousin Fred, a naval officer who has come to Spain on a public relations mission for a U.S. fleet. Not exactly friends in the past, Ted and Fred strike up relationships with women in the Spanish city and experience conflicts -- Ted with his employer, and Fred with the Barcelona community.

876bd18f7c2998e0158c99560a06830c.overview: A young woman urgently seeks to navigate the maze of contemporary Taipei and find a future. She hopes that her boyfriend Lung is the key to the future, but Lung is stuck in a past that combines baseball and traditional loyalty that leads him to squander his nest egg bailing her father out of financial trouble.

879638a8174b6b83861b8bab34ceecd7.overview: A prince in Java tries to seduce his visitor's wife, but he's discovered.

879ab818257cb69b55210bc7095581fe.overview: As political cartoonist Duffy and his bride Meg fail to conceive, he and sorority girl Daphne succeed.
879ab818257cb69b55210bc7095581fe.tagline: Everyone has a biological clock. Duffy Bergman's is about to go off.

87bb9310779bfafcd171f52076ea1873.overview: After the death of her beloved grandmother, eight-year-old Nelly meets a strangely familiar girl her own age in the woods. Instantly forming a connection with this mysterious new friend, Nelly embarks on a fantastical journey of discovery which helps her come to terms with this newfound loss.
87bb9310779bfafcd171f52076ea1873.tagline: Experience a fairytale of wonder and innocence.

87cf791850020f033048cd1f9d933ceb.overview: Following the Civil War, headstrong rancher Thomas Dunson decides to lead a perilous cattle drive from Texas to Missouri. During the exhausting journey, his persistence becomes tyrannical in the eyes of Matthew Garth, his adopted son and protégé.
